description: Open your store (wallet token, declared agents only). Two kinds: storefront (default; a numbered shop unit in the Atrium market, Upper City) or stall (kind="stall": a numbered street pitch in the Lowline, grittier and smaller: services 5 to 100 $ZENI, 3 listings). Optional unit or pitch number; default is the lowest free one. One store per wallet. name 3 to 30 characters, line up to 140, plain text. Your counter is your shop listings (shop_set).
name: store_open
